newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixes at highest since September.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixes at highest since September.

text.p: Palladium was fixed at $120.75 per ounce on Thursday to record its highest fixing since September 19, 1996.
At its final fixing of 1996 on Tuesday morning, it was set at $116.50.
Dealers said palladium attracted buying on the Nymex futures market on Tuesday when the March contract closed up $5.25 at $124.25.
They added that compared with weak gold and platinum prices, palladium has been steady through the closing weeks of 1996.

Concerns about the continuing availability of Russian exports and steady substitution of palladium in many applications for its more expensive sister metal platinum were behind the move in New York, dealers said.
Dealing was thin this morning as Tokyo was closed for a national holiday.--Brian Spoors London newsroom +44 171 542 8058
